fewShots.question: Total sales amount and TotalQuantity for FY 2023-24 (FY starting 01-04-2023 to 31-03-2024).
fewShots.query:
SELECT
  SUM(Amount) AS TotalSalesAmount,
  SUM(TotalQuantity) AS TotalQuantity
FROM sales
WHERE InvoiceDate >= DATEFROMPARTS(2023, 4, 1)
  AND InvoiceDate < DATEFROMPARTS(2024, 4, 1);

fewShots.question: Top 10 materials by sales amount in FY 2023-24, including material description.
fewShots.query:
SELECT TOP (10)
  Material,
  MaterialDescription,
  SUM(Amount) AS TotalSalesAmount
FROM sales
WHERE InvoiceDate >= DATEFROMPARTS(2023, 4, 1)
  AND InvoiceDate < DATEFROMPARTS(2024, 4, 1)
GROUP BY Material, MaterialDescription
ORDER BY TotalSalesAmount DESC;

fewShots.question: Monthly sales amount trend for FY 2022-23 in April-to-March sequence.
fewShots.query:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN MONTH(InvoiceDate) >= 4 THEN YEAR(InvoiceDate) ELSE YEAR(InvoiceDate) - 1 END AS FinancialYearStart,
  CASE WHEN MONTH(InvoiceDate) >= 4 THEN MONTH(InvoiceDate) - 3 ELSE MONTH(InvoiceDate) + 9 END AS FinancialMonth,
  DATENAME(month, InvoiceDate) AS MonthName,
  SUM(Amount) AS TotalSalesAmount
FROM sales
WHERE InvoiceDate >= DATEFROMPARTS(2022, 4, 1)
  AND InvoiceDate < DATEFROMPARTS(2023, 4, 1)
GROUP BY
  CASE WHEN MONTH(InvoiceDate) >= 4 THEN YEAR(InvoiceDate) ELSE YEAR(InvoiceDate) - 1 END,
  CASE WHEN MONTH(InvoiceDate) >= 4 THEN MONTH(InvoiceDate) - 3 ELSE MONTH(InvoiceDate) + 9 END,
  DATENAME(month, InvoiceDate)
ORDER BY FinancialMonth;

fewShots.question: Top 10 customers by TotalQuantity in the last 12 months.
fewShots.query:
SELECT TOP (10)
  Customer,
  CustomerName,
  SUM(TotalQuantity) AS TotalQuantity
FROM sales
WHERE InvoiceDate >= DATEADD(month, -12, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
  AND InvoiceDate < CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY Customer, CustomerName
ORDER BY TotalQuantity DESC;

fewShots.question: Count of cancelled invoices in FY 2023-24.
fewShots.query:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceNo) AS CancelledInvoiceCount
FROM sales
WHERE CancelledInvoice IN ('Y', '1', 'Yes')
  AND InvoiceDate >= DATEFROMPARTS(2023, 4, 1)
  AND InvoiceDate < DATEFROMPARTS(2024, 4, 1);

fewShots.question: Top 20 materials by average sales amount per unit, excluding rows with zero or missing quantity.
fewShots.query:
SELECT TOP (20)
  Material,
  MaterialDescription,
  SUM(Amount) / NULLIF(SUM(Quantity), 0) AS SalesAmountPerUnit
FROM sales
WHERE Quantity IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY Material, MaterialDescription
HAVING SUM(Quantity) <> 0
ORDER BY SalesAmountPerUnit DESC;

fewShots.question: Sales amount by country for FY 2023-24.
fewShots.query:
SELECT
  CountryName,
  SUM(Amount) AS TotalSalesAmount
FROM sales
WHERE InvoiceDate >= DATEFROMPARTS(2023, 4, 1)
  AND InvoiceDate < DATEFROMPARTS(2024, 4, 1)
GROUP BY CountryName
ORDER BY TotalSalesAmount DESC;

fewShots.question: Invoice counts by sales organization and distribution channel in FY 2023-24, showing only groups with more than 100 invoices.
fewShots.query:
SELECT
  SalesOrganization,
  DistributionChannel,
  COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceNo) AS InvoiceCount
FROM sales
WHERE InvoiceDate >= DATEFROMPARTS(2023, 4, 1)
  AND InvoiceDate < DATEFROMPARTS(2024, 4, 1)
GROUP BY SalesOrganization, DistributionChannel
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceNo) > 100
ORDER BY InvoiceCount DESC;

fewShots.question: Most recent 20 invoices with date, customer, and sales amount.
fewShots.query:
SELECT TOP (20)
  InvoiceNo,
  InvoiceDate,
  Customer,
  CustomerName,
  Amount
FROM sales
ORDER BY InvoiceDate DESC;

fewShots.question: Find invoices with missing invoice dates.
fewShots.query:
SELECT
  InvoiceNo,
  InvoiceDate,
  Customer,
  CustomerName
FROM sales
WHERE InvoiceDate IS NULL;

fewShots.question: Material group contribution to total sales amount for FY 2023-24, including percentage of total.
fewShots.query:
SELECT
  MaterialGroup,
  SUM(Amount) AS MaterialGroupSalesAmount,
  SUM(Amount) / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(Amount)) OVER (), 0) * 100.0 AS PercentOfTotalSalesAmount
FROM sales
WHERE InvoiceDate >= DATEFROMPARTS(2023, 4, 1)
  AND InvoiceDate < DATEFROMPARTS(2024, 4, 1)
GROUP BY MaterialGroup
ORDER BY MaterialGroupSalesAmount DESC;

fewShots.question: Top 5 plants by sales amount for each financial month in FY 2023-24.
fewShots.query:
WITH MonthlyPlantSales AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN MONTH(InvoiceDate) >= 4 THEN YEAR(InvoiceDate) ELSE YEAR(InvoiceDate) - 1 END AS FinancialYearStart,
    CASE WHEN MONTH(InvoiceDate) >= 4 THEN MONTH(InvoiceDate) - 3 ELSE MONTH(InvoiceDate) + 9 END AS FinancialMonth,
    Plant,
    SUM(Amount) AS PlantSalesAmount
  FROM sales
  WHERE InvoiceDate >= DATEFROMPARTS(2023, 4, 1)
    AND InvoiceDate < DATEFROMPARTS(2024, 4, 1)
  GROUP BY
    CASE WHEN MONTH(InvoiceDate) >= 4 THEN YEAR(InvoiceDate) ELSE YEAR(InvoiceDate) - 1 END,
    CASE WHEN MONTH(InvoiceDate) >= 4 THEN MONTH(InvoiceDate) - 3 ELSE MONTH(InvoiceDate) + 9 END,
    Plant
), RankedPlants AS (
  SELECT
    FinancialYearStart,
    FinancialMonth,
    Plant,
    PlantSalesAmount,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY FinancialYearStart, FinancialMonth
      ORDER BY PlantSalesAmount DESC
    ) AS PlantRank
  FROM MonthlyPlantSales
)
SELECT
  FinancialYearStart,
  FinancialMonth,
  Plant,
  PlantSalesAmount
FROM RankedPlants
WHERE PlantRank <= 5
ORDER BY FinancialYearStart, FinancialMonth, PlantSalesAmount DESC;

fewShots.question: Compare total sales amount and net amount by financial year for all available years.
fewShots.query:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN MONTH(InvoiceDate) >= 4 THEN YEAR(InvoiceDate) ELSE YEAR(InvoiceDate) - 1 END AS FinancialYearStart,
  SUM(Amount) AS TotalSalesAmount,
  SUM(NetAmount) AS TotalNetAmount,
  SUM(Amount) - SUM(NetAmount) AS AmountLessNetAmount
FROM sales
WHERE InvoiceDate IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY CASE WHEN MONTH(InvoiceDate) >= 4 THEN YEAR(InvoiceDate) ELSE YEAR(InvoiceDate) - 1 END
ORDER BY FinancialYearStart;

fewShots.question: Average Billing_Time_Within_Plant by shop, converting valid numeric values only.
fewShots.query:
SELECT
  Shop,
  AVG(TRY_CONVERT(float, Billing_Time_Within_Plant)) AS AverageBillingTimeWithinPlant
FROM sales
GROUP BY Shop
HAVING AVG(TRY_CONVERT(float, Billing_Time_Within_Plant)) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY AverageBillingTimeWithinPlant DESC;

fewShots.question: Total DiscountValue by external material group for FY 2023-24.
fewShots.query:
SELECT
  ExternalMaterialGroup,
  SUM(DiscountValue) AS TotalDiscountValue
FROM sales
WHERE InvoiceDate >= DATEFROMPARTS(2023, 4, 1)
  AND InvoiceDate < DATEFROMPARTS(2024, 4, 1)
GROUP BY ExternalMaterialGroup
ORDER BY TotalDiscountValue DESC;
